name: Floowed
tagline: Floowed is the operations platform: AI agents do tasks; Floowed runs whole operations from first request to outcome.
description: Floowed is an operations platform for AI workflow automation. While AI agents handle single tasks, Floowed runs whole operations from first request to final outcome, across steps, handovers, and systems. Every case repeats five stages as needed: Gather, Interpret, Chase, Decide, and Act. Use it for client and supplier onboarding, due diligence, document-heavy approvals, and other mid-office flows between CRM, accounting, and project tools. Rules can be written in plain words or code. Every case keeps its evidence. Start with $80 of credits (no card). Team from $100/month for 10,000 credits. Credits are shared, not per seat. Integrations, API, and MCP on every plan.
